title: psyllium maderense
intro: Psyllium maderense, commonly known as Madeira mallow, is a species of flowering plant in the family Malvaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, including the ability to support digestive health and promote regular bowel movements due to its high fiber content. The therapeutic actions of Psyllium maderense include soothing and protecting the mucous membranes, as well as exhibiting anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include mucilages, which are complex carbohydrates that provide its soothing and protective effects.
